title: Digital Crime Scene — CIA Breakdown
context: You are a SOC analyst called in to investigate a critical security breach at Meridian General Hospital. Use Linux shell commands to examine the digital evidence and identify which pillars of the CIA Triad were violated. Type each command and press Enter.
description: A hospital has suffered a major security incident. Your job: examine the digital evidence using shell commands, identify which pillars of the CIA Triad were violated, and decode the hidden flag.
hint: The CIA Triad is Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability. Type commands one at a time and press Enter: use 'ls' to list files, 'cat filename' to read a file, 'grep keyword filename' to search. For the final task type: base64 -d hidden_flag.b64
starterCode:
#!/bin/bash
# ============================================
# SENTINEL SECURITY LAB: CIA Crime Scene
# Meridian General Hospital — Breach Investigation
# ============================================
# Evidence files available:
#   breach_report.txt  - Incident summary
#   access_logs.txt    - Server access logs
#   db_changes.log     - Database change records
#   availability.log   - System uptime data
#   hidden_flag.b64    - Encoded flag
#
# Start with: ls
# Then work through each task using the commands shown.
# ============================================
echo "=== INVESTIGATION STARTED ==="
ls

additionalFiles.name: breach_report.txt
additionalFiles.content:
=== INCIDENT REPORT #IR-2024-0047 ===
Organization: Meridian General Hospital
Date: 2024-03-15 02:47:00 UTC
Severity: CRITICAL
Prepared by: SOC Team Alpha

--- EVENT 1: DATA BREACH ---
Unauthorized access to patient management database.
Records affected: 47,823 patient files exfiltrated to external IP.
Data exposed: SSNs, medical histories, insurance details, contact info.
Confidentiality status: COMPROMISED

--- EVENT 2: DATA MANIPULATION ---
Attacker modified 312 patient medication and lab records post-breach.
Altered fields: medication dosages, test results, treatment plans.
Integrity status: COMPROMISED

--- EVENT 3: SYSTEM OUTAGE ---
Ransomware payload deployed. Hospital management system offline for 8 hours.
Affected: Emergency dept, ICU, pharmacy, lab results portal.
Availability status: COMPROMISED

Initial vector: SQL injection via unpatched patient portal (CVE-2024-1234)
Status: UNDER INVESTIGATION

tasks.title: Start the investigation
tasks.desc: Type: ls — lists all evidence files in the lab environment. (This runs automatically when the lab loads.)

tasks.title: Read the incident report
tasks.desc: Type: cat breach_report.txt — reads the full incident summary. How many patient records were stolen?

tasks.title: Find the exfiltration event
tasks.desc: Type: grep -i "exfil" access_logs.txt — searches the server logs for the data theft event. This proves Confidentiality was violated.

tasks.title: Confirm the integrity violation
tasks.desc: Type: grep "INTEGRITY" db_changes.log — confirms unauthorized database tampering. This proves Integrity was violated.

tasks.title: Measure the system downtime
tasks.desc: Type: grep "DOWNTIME" availability.log — reveals the total outage duration. This proves Availability was violated.

tasks.title: Decode the hidden flag
tasks.desc: Type: base64 -d hidden_flag.b64 — decodes and reveals your lab flag. Copy the FLAG{...} and submit it above.
